sec: Parathyroid anatomy, transcription factors and the PTH–VitD–FGF23 loop · p871

items.q: Match parathyroid development — 1) 3rd pharyngeal pouch  2) 4th pharyngeal pouch … A) Superior parathyroid  B) Inferior parathyroid (ectopic intrathyroid m/c)
items.exp: 3rd pouch → inferior parathyroid (ectopic, intrathyroid m/c); 4th pouch → superior parathyroid; endodermal origin at 5–7 weeks. (Book p871)
Tbx1 defect → Di George syndrome (22q microdeletion). (Book p871)

items.q: A GATA3 defect produces the triad of:
opts: Hypoparathyroidism, sensorineural hearing loss, renal dysfunction
items.exp: GATA3 defect → hypoparathyroidism, SNHL, renal dysfunction. (Book p871)

items.q: GCMB and SOX3 defects lead to:
The parathyroid cell with abundant mitochondria and affinity for 99mTc-sestamibi is the:
items.exp: Oxyntic cells contain large mitochondria and take up 99mTc-sestamibi. (Book p871)

items.q: A sestamibi scan shows a hot parathyroid focus. The applied principle is that adenoma has:
items.exp: Adenoma → ↑ oxyntic cells → ↑ uptake of 99mTc-sestamibi (taken up by oxyntic cells). (Book p871)

items.q: Match the PTH–VitD–FGF23 loop — 1) FGF23 on Vit D & PTH  2) PTH on Vit D & FGF23  3) Vit D on PTH & FGF23 … A) (+) Vit D, (+) FGF23  B) (−) PTH, (+) FGF23  C) (−) Vit D, (−) PTH
items.exp: FGF23 inhibits Vit D and PTH; PTH stimulates Vit D and FGF23; Vit D inhibits PTH and stimulates FGF23. (Book p871)

items.q: PTH stimulates vitamin D by activating:
items.exp: PTH (+) 1α-hydroxylase → stimulates Vit D; Vit D (−) parathyroid proliferation → inhibits PTH. (Book p871)
